user.title: Connect to CookieNVR
user.description: Enter the address of your CookieNVR. Next you approve the connection in CookieNVR, no token to copy.

data_description.token: Leave empty. Only needed if you cannot open the CookieNVR approval page; create one under Account, Connect other apps.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add {name}?
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found CookieNVR **{name}** at {url}. Next you approve the connection in CookieNVR.

link_retry.title: Connection not approved
link_retry.description: Select Submit to get a new code and try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {name}
reauth_confirm.description: CookieNVR no longer accepts this connection (it may have been revoked). Select Submit, then approve it again in CookieNVR.

data_description.token: Leave empty to approve in CookieNVR instead.

progress.wait_for_approval:
1. [Open CookieNVR]({url}) and sign in if asked.
2. Check that it shows the code **{code}**.
3. Select **Allow**. This page continues by itself.

The code is valid for 10 minutes.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address
error.link_denied: The connection was denied in CookieNVR
error.link_expired: The code expired before it was approved
error.link_claimed: This code was already used by someone else. Try again to get a new one.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address now belongs to a different CookieNVR
abort.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address
abort.not_cookienvr: This device is not a CookieNVR
abort.link_rate_limited: CookieNVR is receiving too many connection requests. Try again in a few minutes.

ptz_move.name: PTZ move
ptz_move.description: Moves a camera's pan, tilt or zoom.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Defaults to relative when the camera supports it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long a continuous move lasts, in seconds.

ptz_preset.name: PTZ preset
ptz_preset.description: Goes to, saves or deletes a PTZ preset. Saving and deleting need an administrator token.

action.name: Action
action.description: What to do with the preset.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset name or token. When saving, an existing preset to overwrite.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the preset to save.

export_clip.name: Export clip
export_clip.description: Exports a recorded clip to the Home Assistant media folder.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the clip. Use either end or duration.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Clip length in seconds. Use either end or duration.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Defaults to the name CookieNVR picks.

incompatible_version.message: The CookieNVR API version is not supported. See the repair issue.

ptz_no_direction.message: Set at least one of pan, tilt or zoom

ptz_mode_unsupported.message: This camera does not support {mode} moves

preset_name_required.message: Enter a name for the preset

admin_required.message: This needs a token from a CookieNVR administrator

no_media_dir.message: Home Assistant has no media directory configured

export_bad_range.message: The end must be after the start

export_end_or_duration.message: Give either end or duration, not both and not neither

nvr_outdated.title: Update CookieNVR
nvr_outdated.description: CookieNVR {nvr_version} speaks API version {api_version}, but this integration needs {min} to {max}. Please update CookieNVR.

integration_outdated.title: Update the CookieNVR integration
integration_outdated.description: CookieNVR {nvr_version} speaks API version {api_version}, newer than this integration supports ({min} to {max}). Please update the CookieNVR integration.
